AI time-series forecasting and pattern-recognition models projecting FFB pricing, oil yield and weather impacts for plantation operations (vendor case study)

Round-the-clock satellite fire and deforestation monitoring system ('Eye in the Sky') using anomaly-detection algorithms on optical/infrared satellite imagery to flag tree removal and unusual heat patterns across plantations and supplier areas, with automated hotspot alerts relayed to field managers and a dashboard. [Sentinel, Landsat, Planet imagery; Esri ArcGIS Pro/ArcMap; NASA fire data]
deployments_detail.value: >23.4 million hectares monitored; fire detection up to 5 km beyond concession boundaries

deployments_detail.use: Machine-learning 'Devegetation' method built by Wilmar's geospatial team to determine the planting year of oil palm plantations from Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, visualized in an ArcGIS dashboard as an alternative to the Hansen forest-loss method. [Sentinel-2; Esri ArcGIS]

Co-funding and development of the RADD (Radar Alerts for Detecting Deforestation) system — radar-based near-real-time forest disturbance detection that sees through cloud cover — used to monitor palm oil supplier compliance with NDPE policy, published on Global Forest Watch. [Wageningen University / Global Forest Watch (RADD)]
Partnership with Geowatch to launch satellite monitoring detecting deforestation linked to sugar production in Brazil and Thailand, reinforcing oversight under Wilmar's NDPE Sugar Policy. [Geowatch]

AI computer vision combined with IoT sensors to monitor Food Park facilities, equipment and on-site security, detecting anomalies and safety risks.
AI predictive analytics and machine learning to proactively detect patterns, predict equipment failures and optimise maintenance schedules across operations (predictive maintenance).
